Interface KfeChannelRebalanceJobRepository

All Superinterfaces:

@Repository public interface KfeChannelRebalanceJobRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeChannelRebalanceJobEntity,UUID>
Queries, claims, and completes asynchronous channel-rebalance jobs.

    • findClaimCandidates

      @Query("select j from KfeChannelRebalanceJobEntity j\nwhere j.status = \'PENDING\'\n or (j.status = \'IN_PROGRESS\' and (j.leaseExpiresAt is null or j.leaseExpiresAt <= :now))\norder by j.createdAt asc, j.id asc\n") List<KfeChannelRebalanceJobEntity> findClaimCandidates(@Param("now") LocalDateTime now, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Selects pending jobs and jobs whose active worker lease has expired.
      Parameters:
      now - UTC time used to identify expired in-progress claims
      pageable - bounded worker poll size
      Returns:
      oldest eligible jobs first with UUID tie-breaking

    • claim

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeChannelRebalanceJobEntity j\nset j.status = \'IN_PROGRESS\', j.claimedBy = :worker,\n j.claimToken = :token, j.leaseExpiresAt = :until, j.rowVersion = j.rowVersion + 1\nwhere j.id = :id\n and (j.status = \'PENDING\'\n or (j.status = \'IN_PROGRESS\' and (j.leaseExpiresAt is null or j.leaseExpiresAt <= :now)))\n") int claim(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now, @Param("worker") String worker, @Param("token") UUID token, @Param("until") LocalDateTime until)
      Atomically assigns an eligible job to a worker with a fresh fencing token and lease.
      Parameters:
      id - job identifier to claim
      now - current UTC time for checking an expired previous lease
      worker - worker identity taking the claim
      token - fresh claim token required for follow-up writes
      until - UTC deadline for the new lease
      Returns:
      one if the compare-and-set claim succeeds; zero if another worker won or it is ineligible

    • heartbeat

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeChannelRebalanceJobEntity j\nset j.leaseExpiresAt = :until, j.rowVersion = j.rowVersion + 1\nwhere j.id = :id and j.status = \'IN_PROGRESS\'\n and j.claimToken = :token and j.leaseExpiresAt > :now\n") int heartbeat(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("token") UUID token, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now, @Param("until") LocalDateTime until)
      Renews an unexpired lease only for the worker holding the matching token.
      Parameters:
      id - job whose lease is being renewed
      token - active claim token
      now - current UTC time; expired claims cannot heartbeat
      until - new UTC lease deadline
      Returns:
      one when renewed, otherwise zero when ownership or liveness checks fail

    • completeClaimed

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeChannelRebalanceJobEntity j\nset j.status = \'COMPLETED\', j.providerReference = :reference,\n j.completedAt = :now, j.claimedBy = null, j.claimToken = null, j.leaseExpiresAt = null\nwhere j.id = :id and j.status = \'IN_PROGRESS\' and j.claimToken = :token\n") int completeClaimed(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("token") UUID token, @Param("reference") String reference, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now)
      Completes a running job and clears its lease when the claim token matches.
      Parameters:
      id - job to complete
      token - current worker claim token
      reference - provider-side reference to persist
      now - UTC time the job completed
      Returns:
      one when completion is accepted, otherwise zero for a stale/non-active claim

    • failClaimed

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeChannelRebalanceJobEntity j\nset j.status = \'FAILED\', j.lastError = :error,\n j.completedAt = :now, j.claimedBy = null, j.claimToken = null, j.leaseExpiresAt = null\nwhere j.id = :id and j.status = \'IN_PROGRESS\' and j.claimToken = :token\n") int failClaimed(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("token") UUID token, @Param("error") String error, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now)
      Fails a running job and clears its lease when the claim token matches.
      Parameters:
      id - job to fail
      token - current worker claim token
      error - failure detail to store
      now - UTC terminal time for the failed job
      Returns:
      one when failure is accepted, otherwise zero for a stale/non-active claim
